lines.en: Let's clean this shelf today. Can you help?
Sure. Do we need all these cups?
No. We use only four of them.
So I will put the others in a box.
Good. Store the box under the bed.
This bottle is empty. Do you want it?
No. I bought it last year and never used it.
lines.ko: 아니요. 작년에 샀는데 한 번도 안 썼어요.

lines.en: Okay. I will fill this bag with old paper.
lines.ko: 네. 이 가방은 헌 종이로 채울게요.

lines.en: Please cover the table first. It gets dirty.
Okay. Now we have more room here.
lines.ko: 네. 이제 여기 자리가 더 생겼어요.

dialogs.about: 필요한 물건 사러 가기 전 목록 만들기

lines.en: I'm going to the market. What do we need?
We need eggs. The box is empty.
Okay. Do we have enough rice?
Yes, I filled the rice box yesterday.
Good. I want some fruit too.
Get apples. We used the last one this morning.
lines.ko: 사과를 사요. 오늘 아침에 마지막 사과를 먹었어요.

lines.en: I will write it on my note.
Do you have your own bag?
Yes. I keep it by the door.
Great. Come back soon, and I will make tea.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 빨리 와요, 그러면 내가 차를 만들게요.
